title: Which Čiurlionis painting for A2-1915
ask: "Between Worlds" is the title of the Dulwich Picture Gallery's 2022–23 Čiurlionis exhibition, not of a single painting. Fable proposes Karalių pasaka (The Kings' Fairy Tale, 1909); the alternative is Rex (1909). Both are public domain.

title: "…, prašau" at the end of a request
ask: The etiquette reference Fable checked (Kniūkšta, ed., Kalbos etiketas, 2004) calls a command with prašau at the end, as in Užrašykite, prašau, a Russian-pattern borrowing. It recommends Prašom užrašyti (prašom + the infinitive) instead. Everyday speech uses the end-position form all the time, and we couldn't check the language commission's current position (vlkk.lt blocked access). Four cards use it: pakartokite, užrašykite, kalbėkite lėčiau, sėskitės. Either way, the note on the back will give the recommended form.

title: mama / tėtis before or after motina / tėvas?
ask: The mother and father cards will now sit together in the study order. Right now the everyday words (mama, tėtis) come straight after the formal ones (motina, tėvas). Reverse it so the everyday word comes first?

title: Backs and Type: three decisions on one page
ask: Current vs proposed backs (6 cards), thumbnail vs full picture (3 cards), and the deck in five typefaces. Noto Serif and Brygada 1918 are the only ones that place the tilde correctly over ė and ū; the current mix and Old Standard TT let it collide. Answer on that page.
